title: Multirotor
text: Compute aerodynamic forces and moments, 9 inputs, 4 outputs, {Thrust coefficient (CT)} sets Thrust coefficient; {Units} sets the input and output units Metric, {Modeling} sets the rotor thrust calculation method Without flap, {Include pitch angle inputs} enables pitch angle inputs, {Configuration} sets the vehicle configuration Quadcopter, {Arm length (m)} sets the vehicle arm length, {Height (m)} sets the vertical offset from vehicle center, {CT and CQ Source} sets the dropdown to select the source of thrust and torque coefficient, {Torque coefficient (CQ)} sets the torque coefficient 7.8263e-4, {Number of blades}, {Output computed CT and CQ} sets the output computed thrust coefficient and torque, {Radius (m)} sets the rotor radius, {Chord (m)} sets the blade chord, {Hinge offset (m)}, {Lift curve slope (per rad)}, {Mean drag coefficient}, {Lock number}, {Twist distribution} sets the rotor blade twist, {Blade root angle (rad)} sets the blade root pitch angle, {Blade twist angle (rad)} and {Blade tip angle (rad)} sets the blade tip pitch angle. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: V b
ports.summary: Body velocity of rotor 3-by-1 vector | 1-by-3 vector

ports.summary: Lateral cyclic pitch angle N-by-1 vector | 1-by-N vector

ports.name: θ s
ports.summary: Longitudinal cyclic pitch angle N-by-1 vector | 1-by-N vector

ports.name: C T

ports.name: C Q

params.name: Units
params.values: Input and output units Metric (MKS) (default) | English (Velocity in ft/s) | English (Velocity in kts)

params.name: Modeling
params.values: Rotor thrust calculation method Without flap effects (default) | With flap effects

params.name: Include pitch angle inputs
params.values: Enable pitch angle inputs off (default) | on

params.name: Configuration
params.values: Vehicle configuration Quadcopter X (default) | Quadcopter +

params.name: Arm length (m)
params.values: Vehicle arm length 0.0624 (default) | nonzero positive scalar

params.name: Height (m)
params.values: Vertical offset from vehicle center of gravity -0.0159 (default) | nonzero scalar

params.name: CT and CQ Source
params.values: Dropdown to select the source of thrust and torque coefficient values ’Dialog’ (default) | ’Compute using BEMT’ | ’Ports’

params.name: Thrust coefficient (CT)
params.values: Thrust coefficient 0.0107 (default) | nonzero positive scalar | nonzero positive N-by-1 vector

params.name: Torque coefficient (CQ)
params.values: Torque coefficient 7.8263e-4 (default) | nonzero positive scalar | nonzero positive N-by-1 vector

params.name: Number of blades
params.values: Number of blades per rotor 2 (default) | nonzero positive scalar

params.name: Output computed CT and CQ
params.values: Output computed thrust coefficient and torque coefficient off (default) | on
